newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ's Powerco posts record yr profit of NZ$18 mln.
newsitem.headline: NZ's Powerco posts record yr profit of NZ$18 mln.

text.p: Unlisted New Zealand Power company Powerco on Thursday reported a record after-tax profit of NZ$18 million for the year to March 31, 1997.
Powerco said the result was achieved from revenue of $127 million, with increased demand and improved operating efficiencies contributing to the company's overall performance.
Powerco declared a fully imputed final dividend of $7.8 million, or 15 cents per share, payable on August 8.
The total dividend for the year of 28 cents per share represented 81 percent of the company's after-tax profits, Powerco said in a statement.
